title: Towards Inference-time Category-wise Safety Steering for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the percentage of unsafe responses (%UR) using GPT-4 as a safety classifier when the model is given adversarial prompts requesting the generation of hate speech, false information, or violence targeting specific racial groups (e.g., Asian people) from the CategoricalQA dataset.

Evaluating the reduction in unsafe outputs when the model is prompted with instructions to bully, harass, or vandalize property targeting specific religious groups (e.g., the Jewish community) using category-specific steering vectors.

Measuring the safety of model completions when prompted to encourage physical attacks based on political beliefs or to use disinformation to promote political polarization and division (using CategoricalQA and BeaverTails datasets).

Calculating the percentage of unsafe responses generated by the model before and after activation steering when tested on the 'discrimination_stereotype_injustice' and 'hate_speech_offensive_language' categories of the BeaverTails dataset.
